title: porophyllum ruderale var. macrocephalum
intro: Porophyllum ruderale var. macrocephalum, commonly known as "Mexican daisy" or "cotullin", is a perennial plant belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. These bioactive constituents contribute to the plant's ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and boost the immune system.
